title: Data Engineer GCP
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are Seeking a "Data Engineer" to build, optimize, and maintain the modern data platform within a cloud environment.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Work experience on relational l & non-relational databases platform
  • Design, build, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines for batch and real-time processing, from ingestion to final consumption.
  • Construct and manage the data lake infrastructure (multi-cloud), ensuring governance, security, and scalability.
  • Administer and optimize various database management systems (DBMS) , including relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Implement real-time data stream processing solutions using technologies like Apache Kafka or similar.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, observability, and reliability through testing, monitoring, and pipeline versioning.
  • Implement and enforce data security and privacy policies.
  • Automate repetitive data engineering and management tasks, applying DevOps and CI/CD principles.
  • Proven experience in data engineering, focusing on both batch and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Spark, Airflow, Databricks).
  • Deep knowledge of GCP cloud environments and data-related services.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with both relational and non-relational databases.
  • Experience with data streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka or managed cloud services.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.



What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Cloud/AI Engineer
description:
Position Summary:

Global Technology - Digital & Innovation team is committed to empowering our business through impactful solutions using Cloud & AI. This team is crucial in building efficient, cutting-edge solutions leveraging AI to bring transformative value to the organization.

We are seeking a "Senior Engineer – Cloud & AI" to drive the development through deployment of cutting-edge cloud-native AI solutions. This role requires a combination of deep technical expertise in Microsoft Azure, strong DevOps and CI/CD practices, and an engineering mindset focused on delivering impactful and value-centric solutions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative team player who thrives in both research-oriented problem solving and timeline-driven execution. The individual comes with a proven background on deploying Generative AI workloads (LLM’s, LVM’s, TTS, Speech to Text etc.) cloud native, with “Security by design” using Commercial (for ex: Azure OpenAI), or Open-source (for ex: Llama, Mistral etc.) models.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive the design, development, and deployment of cloud-native Generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure.
  • Implement and maintain DevOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and version control using GitHub or Azure DevOps.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, AI/ML teams, and business stakeholders to deploy and optimize AI models within cloud-native architectures, ensuring seamless integration and performance at scale.
  • Drive cloud architecture decisions in partnership with Enterprise Architecture, TechOps, and Cybersecurity functions, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to streamline the deployment process and ensure rapid delivery of high-quality applications.
  • Advocate and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate infrastructure provisioning, ensuring consistency across environments.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, promoting a culture of teamwork and innovation.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring team members, and fostering a continuous learning environment.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends in Azure services, AI technologies, and DevOps practices to recommend innovative solutions.

Standard Job Requirements:

  • Experience in Microsoft Azure : Deep understanding of Azure services, including but not limited to Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Container Apps Environment, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Cognitive Services.
  • Experience in Generative AI : Experience working on full-stack Gen AI solution deployments through rapid-prototyping, MVP to Production grade enterprise solutions both with Commercial, Open source models, and Generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex etc., with deeper understanding of Global AI regulations, and AI Governance.
  • DevOps & CI/CD : Proven experience in DevOps practices, including setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Infrastructure as Code : Hands-on experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
  • AI Integration : Experience in integrating AI/ML models into cloud solutions to enhance business processes and outcomes.
  • Strong Engineering with Research Mindset : Ability to approach problems with a research-oriented mindset, exploring new technologies and methods to achieve optimal solutions.
  • Value-Centric Approach : Ability to balance timelines and deliverables with a strong focus on delivering value-driven solutions.
  • Collaborative & Independent : Excellent team player who can collaborate effectively across teams but is also capable of working independently with minimal supervision.


Education, Experience & Soft skills:

  • Minimum Bachelor's degree (Masters Degree preferred) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
  • Experience in Cloud & AI, with Generative AI
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deliverables simultaneously.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks.

description:

Buscamos um Arquiteto de Nuvem Azure altamente qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica. O candidato ideal terá vasta experiência em projetar, implementar e gerenciar soluções baseadas em nuvem no Microsoft Azure. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de nuvem Azure para atender aos requisitos de negócios.
  • Desenvolver e manter padrões e melhores práticas de arquitetura de nuvem.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções de nuvem estejam alinhadas aos requisitos dos aplicativos.
  • Realizar avaliações de prontidão para a nuvem e fornecer recomendações para a adoção da nuvem.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar a infraestrutura de nuvem em termos de desempenho, custo e segurança.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para implantações automatizadas.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as políticas de segurança e regulamentações do setor.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e mentoria aos membros da equipe.
  • Solucionar problemas relacionados à infraestrutura e aos serviços de nuvem.
  • Manter-se atualizado com os serviços, recursos e melhores práticas mais recentes do Azure.

QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada.
  • - Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Nuvem Azure ou função similar.
  • - Sólido conhecimento de conceitos de computação em nuvem e arquitetura Azure.
  • Proficiência em serviços Azure, como Azure Policies, Azure vNets, Private Endpoints, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure RBAC, entre outros.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de infraestrutura como código, como modelos ARM, Microsoft Bicep, Azure Resource Manager e Terraform.
  • Conhecimento de redes, conceitos básicos de TCP/IP, segurança e gerenciamento de identidade no Azure.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.
  • Fluência em inglês falado e escrito.
  • Certificações Azure (por exemplo, Azure Solutions Architect Expert - AZ 305) são um diferencial.

HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem híbrida.
  • Familiaridade com outras plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Google Cloud). - Conhecimento de práticas e ferramentas de DevOps.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e registro de logs, como Azure Monitor, Log Analytics e Application Insights.

O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

title: Professor(a) Assistente Bilíngue - Ensino Fundamental I
description:
Olá!


Agradecemos seu interesse em fazer parte da equipe Beacon School.


Procuramos um(a) profissional que compartilhe dos nossos valores e que tenha as competências que consideramos essenciais para a nossa comunidade escolar: flexibilidade, desejo contínuo de aprendizado, motivação, curiosidade e prazer em trabalhar em equipe.


O(a) profissional selecionado(a) prestará assistência ao Professor em suas atividades educacionais e na aplicação do conteúdo pedagógico programado, além de criar um vínculo positivo com os alunos para garantir o melhor aproveitamento do planejamento previsto.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Recepcionar os alunos quando da sua chegada à Escola.
  • Auxiliar o Professor nas suas atividades de ensino em geral, ajudando-o a manter a atenção dos alunos durante as aulas.
  • Abordar os alunos individualmente durante o horário de aula, esclarecendo dúvidas e auxiliando o Professor na condução da turma.
  • Auxiliar os novos alunos no processo de adaptação à Escola.
  • Monitorar os alunos nos horários de intervalos para lanche e refeição, mantendo a higiene e limpeza do local e certificando-se que estejam se alimentando adequadamente.
  • Supervisionar os alunos durante as atividades do playground, planejando juntamente com o professor essas respectivas atividades.
  • Supervisionar os alunos quando vão ao banheiro, orientando-os com relação aos procedimentos de higiene.
  • Acompanhar os alunos nas atividades extracurriculares, bem como as ligadas a Artes/Corpo & Movimento.
  • Acompanhar as discussões e disputas entre os alunos, intervindo quando necessário, a fim de promover um ambiente de harmonia, amizade e respeito.
  • Substituir eventualmente o professor quando da sua ausência da sala de aula.
  • Verificar diariamente a agenda de cada aluno observando as anotações, recados e outras informações pertinentes.
  • Executar a posologia de medicamentos prescritos aos alunos, quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os alunos em atividades externas promovidas pela Escola, tais como, visitas de estudos, viagens, passeios etc.
  • Contribuir com o Professor no processo de alfabetização dos alunos em idioma inglês.
  • Assistir o professor na condução da turma em sala de aula, auxiliando-o na aplicação de medidas disciplinares necessárias ao processo de ensino/aprendizagem dos alunos.
  • Ajudar a avaliar o desempenho dos alunos com relação aos deveres e exercícios, observando seus respectivos cadernos.
  • Auxiliar o Professor continuamente, na avaliação do desenvolvimento individual de cada aluno em todas as áreas do Curriculo Escolar.
  • Cuidar do desenvolvimento das atitudes e comportamentos dos alunos, expressos no “Perfil do Estudante – PYP”.
  • Discutir com o Professor as atividades a serem aplicadas, de forma que estas reforcem os comportamentos e atitudes previstas no PYP.
  • Participais de reuniões semanais de planejamento, com Professores e Coordenador Pedagógico, submetendo-se às orientações relativas a dinâmica de trabalho, conteúdo, estratégias, atitudes, etc.
  • Organizar os espaços, brinquedos, recursos audiovisuais e outros materiais a serem utilizados em sala de aula.
  • Requisitar pequenos reparos ou consertos à equipe de manutenção, visando a disponibilidade dos materiais, equipamentos e instalações do ambiente de aula.
  • Checar a frequência diária dos alunos em classe, lançando as informações em relatório específico e encaminhando-o à Secretaria da Escola.
  • Auxiliar na organização e participar dos eventos escolares com pais, alunos e professores, tais como “open house”, dia das mães, dia dos pais, de Ação de Graças, encerramento de ano e outros previamente definidos pela Escola.
  • Organizar as pastas individuais dos alunos, que constituem as atividades dos mesmos durante o ano letivo, bem como, montar o Yearbook individual para entrega a cada aluno no encerramento do ano.
  • Auxiliar o Professor na edição e formatação dos Reports individuais, documentando o processo de desenvolvimento do aluno.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

FORMAÇÃO: Ensino Superior em Pedagogia

IMPORTANTE: Experiência em escolas bilíngues. Conhecimento do currículo PYP / IB ou em PBL.

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis parceiro da Apolar Jardim Botânico é um profissional dinâmico e proativo, responsável pela comercialização de imóveis prontos (usados) e lançamentos em Curitiba e Região Metropolitana.

Como ter sucesso no cargo: O sucesso nesta função é impulsionado pela capacidade de entender e antecipar as necessidades dos clientes, oferecendo soluções imobiliárias que geram valor. Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. Profissionais que se destacam são aqueles que cultivam relações de confiança, dominam as técnicas de negociação, e mantêm-se atualizados sobre o mercado imobiliário e as condições de financiamento. A colaboração com a equipe e o alinhamento com os objetivos da franquia são diferenciais para alcançar o sucesso.

Responsabilidades
  • Angariar Imóveis: Identificar e angariar ativamente imóveis (usados e lançamentos) na região de Curitiba e Região Metropolitana, expandindo o portfólio da franquia e visando atingir a meta de 100 imóveis em carteira.
  • Gestão de Leads: Gerenciar e qualificar leads provenientes de diversas fontes (portais de anúncio, anúncios patrocinados, portal da Rede Apolar, LAIS), realizando o primeiro contato, acompanhamento e nutrição para convertê-los em clientes qualificados.
  • Uso de CRM: Determinar e desenvolver requisitos de usuários para sistemas em produção (Apolar Sales), garantindo o preenchimento completo e organizado de todas as informações de clientes, imóveis e interações, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado, compreendendo a real necessidade do cliente, apresentando as opções de imóveis mais adequadas e conduzindo visitas de forma eficaz.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Conduzir processos de negociação de compra e venda, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de contratos, garantindo a segurança e transparência em todas as etapas da transação.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe: Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de corretores, gerência e franqueados parceiros, compartilhando informações de mercado, estratégias e melhores práticas para otimização dos resultados coletivos.
  • Avaliação de Imóveis: Colaborar no processo de avaliação de imóveis quando solicitado, utilizando o conhecimento de mercado e, se certificado, o registro no CNAI.
  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado/a sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário de Curitiba, novas legislações, condições de financiamento e o perfil de cada bairro para oferecer um serviço consultivo de excelência.


Qualificações
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo. Curso superior, é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • Registro Profissional: Possuir registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (CRECI).
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia comprovada na comercialização de imóveis, com preferência para atuação em imóveis usados e/ou lançamentos.
  • Competências de Comunicação: Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e habilidade para se comunicar por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Habilidade Tecnológica: Familiaridade e disposição para utilizar ferramentas de CRM (Apolar Sales) e outras tecnologias para gestão de leads, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações.
  • Proatividade e Resiliência: Capacidade de agir com proatividade na busca por resultados e na angariação de imóveis, além de resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do mercado.
  • Orientação para o Cliente: Forte orientação para o cliente, com foco em entender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos de confiança e proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva.
  • Organização: Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes para manter registros precisos e acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Infraestrutura: Possuir carro, notebook, acesso à internet fora do escritório e celular para desempenho das atividades.

Para se candidatar entrar em contato através do e-mail: ou através do celular (WhatsApp) .

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior
description:
A Paybyrd é uma plataforma global de pagamentos omnichannel , com presença em Rio de Janeiro , São Paulo e Lisboa . focada em ajudar empresas a oferecer experiências de pagamento modernas, simples e sem fricção – online e presencialmente. A gente integra e-commerce, POS, links de pagamento e outros canais em um único ecossistema, suportando diversos métodos e moedas ao redor do mundo. Com tecnologia flexível, APIs abertas e soluções altamente customizáveis, a Paybyrd permite que cada negócio crie a jornada de pagamento do seu jeito, aumentando taxa de aprovação, melhorando a experiência do cliente e dando visibilidade em tempo real sobre todos os pagamentos.


Principais Atividades

· Trazer padrões de arquitetura considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, resiliência, segurança e custos;

· Fazer entregas de alta qualidade utilizando boas práticas como clean code, testes, ci/cd, dry, solid e etc;

· Resolver os problemas de forma autónoma;

· Participar do crescimento técnico de outras pessoas da equipe;

· Colaborar com a equipe na resolução de bugs ou incidentes de alta complexidade quando necessário;

· Colaborar na tomada de decisão sobre a evolução do produto e da tecnologia.



Requisitos


Arquiteturas modernas focadas em escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade, resiliência, segurança e boas práticas de cloud (12-Factor, microsserviços, APIs bem definidas, etc.);

Desenvolvimento backend em .NET (.NET 6+ e .NET Framework) criando APIs REST, serviços de background e integrações com outros sistemas;

Desenvolvimento frontend com frameworks modernos (ex.: React/Angular), SPA, componentização, consumo de APIs, autenticação e gestão de estado;

Modelagem e acesso a dados usando SQL Server (queries otimizadas, índices, procedures) e bancos NoSQL como Cosmos DB ;

Uso de cache distribuído com Redis para melhoria de performance, redução de latência e alívio de carga em serviços e bases de dados;

Integração assíncrona e desacoplada usando Azure Service Bus e outras soluções de mensageria em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;

Observabilidade e monitorização com ElasticSearch (logging estruturado, correlação de requests, dashboards, alertas e troubleshooting em produção);

Arquitetura orientada a eventos (event-driven), usando padrões como event sourcing, publish/subscribe e integração entre serviços;

Pipelines de CI/CD no Azure DevOps , com build, testes automatizados, code quality, versionamento e deploy automatizado para diferentes ambientes;

Soluções em Azure (App Services, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights, etc.), desenhando aplicações cloud-native e seguras;

Versionamento de código com Git , fluxo de trabalho com pull requests, code review, branching strategy (GitFlow/Trunk Based) e boas práticas de colaboração;

Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, testes de API), TDD/BDD quando aplicável, garantindo qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade do código.


Diferenciais

· Noções de segurança de código e ataques de API comuns;

· Ferramentas APM;

· Tunning.

Assegurar a correta contabilização das operações da empresa, garantindo a integridade das informações financeiras, a conformidade com normas contábeis e fiscais e o suporte a gestão por meio de análises, conciliações e relatórios gerencias.


RESPONSIBILIDADES


  1. Realizar conciliações de contas contábeis, incluindo clientes, fornecedores, estoque e demais contas do balanço.
  2. Realizar lançamentos contábeis e ajustes de contas.
  3. Coletar, validar e registrar as despesas com cartões corporativos e despesas com funcionários.
  4. Executar rotinas de importação e conferência da folha de pagamento no sistema.
  5. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, preparando documentos, relatórios e esclarecimentos necessários.
  6. Realizar processos de intercompany, garantindo a correta conciliação e registro das operações entre empresas do grupo.
  7. Emitir nota fiscal de importação, receber o faturamento do despachante aduaneiro e realizar todos os lançamentos pertinente a operação.
  8. Registrar e controlar despesas antecipadas e ativo imobilizado, garantindo o rateio correto e amortização mensal.
  9. Auxiliar no fechamento contábil mensal e anual, garantindo prazos e qualidade das informações.
  10. Contribuir na melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis, propondo ajustes e automatizações quando necessário.


REQUISITOS


ESCOLARIDADE: Superior Bacharelado em ciências contábeis ou afins

EXPERIÊNCIA: 1 a 3 anos de experiência


HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS :


  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis
  • Habilidade no Pacote Office principalmente Excel do intermediário para avançado.
  • Conhecimento sólido em contabilidade geral.
  • Experiência com conciliação de contas.
  • Conhecimento em intercompany, ativo imobilizado e despesas antecipadas.
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de folha de pagamento.
  • Domínio de Sistemas ERP.
  • Inglês desejável.
  • Ter participado de projetos de automação ou melhoria contínua será considerado um diferencial
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar informações financeiras e identificar inconsistências.
  • Proatividade para buscar soluções, melhoras processos e antecipar necessidades da área.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Comprometimento com prazos e habilidades para trabalhar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas.
  • Trabalho em equipe, colaborando com diferentes setores e compartilhando informações de forma clara.

title: Ejecutivo/a de cuentas y operaciones Brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto : Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar: Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:
• Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas: Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
• Experiencia Profesional en Turismo: Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2B.
• Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil : Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.
Competencias sociales y personales:
• Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad: Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
• Multitarea y gestión de la presión: Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
• Competencias interpersonales y comunicación: Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
• Orientación al cliente: Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.
Lo que ofrecemos:
• Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia
• Contrato local con beneficios complementarios
• Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo
• Participación en un proyecto innovador y en plena expansión, con un excelente ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de crecimiento
Para presentar su candidatura, envíe su CV y una carta de presentación a , especificando en qué medida su experiencia y aptitudes se ajustan a los requisitos de este puesto. Esperamos darle la bienvenida a nuestro equipo y hacer de nuestra colaboración un éxito conjunto.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externa - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.


Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.


Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.


Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora, são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • Primam pela excelência na execução como forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem um ambiente inclusivo e um bom clima tanto para as pessoas que trabalham no Meli como para o negócio.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar na região de Guarulhos - SP.


O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Executivo(a) de Contas – ERP | Goiânia
description:
Descrição da vaga


Você tem sangue nos olhos por novos negócios? É movido pela adrenalina de fechar o primeiro contrato e acredita que negócio bom se fecha no aperto de mão ?


Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo de Contas Hunter para atuar em modelo Presencial e Externo em Goiânia .


Sua missão é clara: Expandir o Market Share da TOTVS . Você será a face da empresa no mercado, usando seu carro para visitar prospects, mapear oportunidades e conduzir negociações complexas. Se você é ambicioso, tem perfil desbravador e disponibilidade total para estar na rua, seu lugar é aqui.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Visitas e Prospecção: Realizar visitas presenciais constantes a prospects para diagnóstico e apresentação de soluções, garantindo uma agenda ativa e externa.
  • Mapeamento de Mercado (Hunter): Atuar ativamente na identificação de oportunidades e abertura de novos mercados na região de Goiânia.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vendas: Gerenciar o funil de ponta a ponta, desde a visita inicial e elaboração de proposta até o fechamento do contrato.
  • Venda Consultiva: Desenvolver planos táticos e abordagens comerciais que demonstrem valor real para o negócio do cliente.
  • Registro de Atividades: Registrar todas as visitas comerciais e atualizações de negociação no CRM para garantir a visibilidade do pipeline.
  • Networking: Participar de eventos e promover iniciativas que gerem leads qualificados para a sua carteira.


Requisitos e qualificações


O que é indispensável para a posição:

  • Mobilidade (Obrigatório): Possuir Veículo Próprio e CNH B ativa. A vaga exige deslocamento constante para visitas.
  • Experiência Hunter: Vivência mínima de 02 anos em vendas externas, com forte atuação em prospecção e visitas a clientes.
  • Formação: Graduação completa (Administração, TI, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins).
  • Venda de Tecnologia: Domínio de técnicas de Vendas Consultivas B2B.
  • Ferramentas: Excel, PowerPoint e Google Workspace.


Diferenciais que nos conquistam:

  • Experiência com ERP: Ter vendido software de gestão (ERP) é o grande trunfo para essa vaga.
  • Networking Local: Conhecer o mercado e as empresas da região de Goiânia.
  • CRM: Experiência no uso de CRMs (Salesforce, Pipedrive, TOTVS CRM).


Local de Trabalho e Modelo


  • Local: Goiânia, GO.
  • Modelo Presencial e Externo: A rotina combina a atuação estratégica no escritório com uma agenda intensa de visitas a clientes e prospects .

title: Analista de Planejamento (Projetos) Sênior
description:

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.


Objetivo do Cargo: Garantir o planejamento eficiente e o acompanhamento detalhado de projetos de engenharia, assegurando que sejam executados dentro dos prazos, custos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos. Será responsável por elaborar cronogramas, alocar recursos, monitorar o progresso dos projetos e mitigar riscos, visando a otimização de processos e a maximização da eficiência. Além disso, deve fornecer suporte estratégico para a alta gestão, por meio de relatórios e análises de desempenho, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões e a realização bem-sucedida dos projetos.

  • Gerar relatórios de progresso, indicadores e dados para a diretoria.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos durante a execução dos projetos.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes multidisciplinares para garantir o cumprimento de prazos e qualidade.
  • Implementar melhorias nos processos de planejamento e execução, visando otimizar custos e tempo.
  • Apoiar na elaboração e monitoramento de contratos, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Teaching Intern
description:
Intern, Primary Division (Pedagogy, Licenciatura, Physical Education, Arts)


About Avenues

Avenues is one school with many campuses, providing transformative, world-focused learning experiences to students around the globe. Avenues prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining a global curriculum based on language immersion and interdisciplinary learning with a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.


About the Role


Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution


Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


The Avenues Intern Program (A.I.P) is a two-year on-site teacher preparation program that offers early career educators the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a Primary Division language immersion setting for them to follow a path in any school setting. Interns collaborate closely with grade-level colleagues in all aspects of classroom life and beyond. In addition to their classroom work, interns will participate in bi-weekly meetings where they explore issues essential to primary education and discuss how these issues are playing out in our classrooms. These meetings also offer interns the opportunity to share and reflect upon their experiences, thereby gaining new perspectives. In your role, you will:

  • Support class and specialist teachers to develop and teach engaging, creative curriculum and lessons, aligned with Avenues expectations and approach
  • Support the day-to-day functioning of the class and school
  • Collaborate closely with a team of teachers responsible for classes of students
  • Participate actively in ongoing professional learning


About You

  • Desire to learn early childhood and elementary teaching foundations and best practices in an immersion setting
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Superb ability to collaborate with colleagues to achieve goals
  • Currently studying toward a teaching degree in a Brazilian university, either in primary education (pedagogia) or another subject (licenciatura )


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Fund Manager
description:

Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.


About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.


Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.


✨ Ready to elevate your career and lead with impact?

job context

and purpose

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights.   • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material

  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

title: Junior Registration Analyst
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

***Candidate Must Be Located in Joinville, Santa Catarina***

As a Junior Registration Analyst at  Syndigo ,  you’ll  play a key role in ensuring product information is  accurate , complete, and ready for approval. This position is perfect for detail-oriented individuals who enjoy working with data and supporting quality processes.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Review and interpret product packaging information and enter it into our technology platform
  • Ensure all data follows predefined guidelines and models
  • Audit content created by team members and third-party contributors for accuracy
  • Validate and correct information before manufacturer approval
  • Communicate with customers to provide guidance and request approval of  finalized content

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • Completed secondary education  required ; higher education (in progress or completed) is a plus
  • Technical Skills: Comfortable with Windows systems and Microsoft Office tools
  • Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail, ability to follow structured processes, and clear communication skills
  • Experience:  No prior experience  required — we’ll  provide training!
  • Ability to work in-person at our Joinville office, 5 days a week.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth! 

GDPR/CCPA

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information
The Team
Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:


Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP.


About John Deere & the Role

John Deere is a global technology company providing software and equipment for agriculture, construction, and forestry. With a strong presence in Brazil and Latin America for over 30 years, the company operates key manufacturing sites in São Paulo, Goiás, and Rio Grande do Sul.


For 2025, John Deere is accelerating its focus on autonomous solutions, AI, and connectivity. To support this expansion, John Deere is building a new team in Brazil to develop and scale applications that enhance digital products and services.


As a Senior Software Engineer – Full-Stack (Front-End Heavy), you will primarily contribute to the design and development of modern front-end applications using React, while occasionally working on backend services. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies, including Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI), to enhance customer-facing applications.


You will leverage technologies like React, APIs, cloud platforms, and AI/GenAI tools to create intuitive, scalable, and secure applications that improve the customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development – Build scalable, high-performance front-end applications using React.
  • UI/UX Collaboration – Work closely with designers and product teams to deliver intuitive, customer-centric interfaces.
  • Backend Integration – Contribute to backend development when needed, with a focus on Python or Java (differential).
  • API Development & Integration – Connect front-end solutions with APIs and ensure smooth data flow across platforms.
  • Cloud & DevOps Enablement – Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment.
  • Technology Exploration – Evaluate and adopt emerging tools, including ML/GenAI, to drive innovation and improve productivity.
  • Quality & Security by Design – Apply best practices in coding, testing, and security to ensure robust and reliable solutions.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Deliver modern, React-based user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend systems.
  • Ensure front-end solutions are scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute across the stack when necessary.
  • Support the adoption of AI and GenAI to enhance customer-facing applications.
  • Maintain alignment with John Deere’s vision for autonomous operations, AI, and digital optimization.


Experience & Qualifications

  • Must-have: Extensive hands-on experience with React and front-end frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a focus on user experience.
  • Collaborative mindset, willing to contribute to both front-end and backend tasks.
  • Differential: Experience with Python or Java for backend development.
  • Differential: Experience in Machine Learning (ML) or Generative AI (GenAI) projects.
  • Differential: Exposure to multi-cloud environments or full-stack design patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced/Fluent English to collaborate in an international environment.


Location: Indaiatuba, SP

Model: Hybrid – 3x per week at the office

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Principal Software Engineer


Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Principal Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP.


About John Deere & Role

John Deere is a global technology company providing software and equipment for agriculture, construction, and forestry. With a strong presence in Brazil and Latin America for over 30 years, the company operates key manufacturing sites in São Paulo, Goiás, and Rio Grande do Sul.


For 2025, John Deere is focused on advancing autonomous solutions, AI, and connectivity. To support its expansion, John Deere is building a new team in Brazil to manage the entire database infrastructure, focusing on SQL and Oracle Database. This team will drive innovation through Self-Service (enabling greater access and usability), Optimization (improving performance and efficiency), and Autonomous Operations (leveraging automation for scalability and reliability).


As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in transforming and innovating Distributed Database Platforms. Your work will align with John Deere's vision of delivering highly automated, AI-driven, and cloud-enabled data platforms, enhancing infrastructure solutions for better customer experiences. A key responsibility is maintaining quality and security by design, implementing best practices that uphold governance, security, and performance standards.


This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies such as data, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and cloud platforms to develop intuitive, self-healing, and optimized database solutions. You will collaborate across global teams, working across full technology stacks to solve enterprise-scale challenges, drive technology adoption, and influence change within a dynamic environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Backend Development - Design and implement scalable backend solutions for SQL and Oracle automation.
  • Database Platform Architecture - Define and build the foundation for a next-gen database platform.
  • API & AI Integration - Develop APIs and integrate AI-driven automation for enhanced performance.
  • Cloud & DevOps - Ensure cloud readiness using containers, microservices, and CI/CD.
  • Technology Integration - Work on seamless adoption of new technologies within existing systems.
  • Strategic Contribution - Help shape the team’s vision and long-term database automation strategy.
  • Autonomy & Proactivity - Take initiative, adapt to changes, and go beyond assigned tasks.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Design and build distributed database platforms to enhance the customer experience.
  • Define and drive innovative architectural solutions for platforms, customer interactions, and database products.
  • Align with the Product Pillars (Autonomous Operations and Optimization), ensuring effective integration into the platform.
  • Leverage AI to enhance systems and optimize processes as a Self-Service Product.
  • Shape the architecture and platform, including decisions around low-level configurations.
  • Ensure quality and security are integral to all processes and solutions.
  • Collaborate across teams to solve complex problems and implement cutting-edge technologies.


Experience & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in backend languages such as Python, C++, or Java, with experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with DBMS technologies, including SQLServer, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, with experience in containers and microservices.
  • Proven experience leveraging security and lean development principles such as CI/CD pipelines for scalability and continuous delivery.
  • Ability to understand and work with APIs, AI prompts, and data contexts to ensure seamless integration across systems.
  • Strong ability to integrate with existing technologies while defining new integration approaches.
  • Differential: Experience with full-stack design patterns, Machine Learning, AI, or GenAI using large language models.
  • Differential: Experience designing and building multi-cloud solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in an engineering field (e.g., Computer Engineering, Technology, etc.).
  • Advanced/Fluent English to report and collaborate in an international environment.


Location: Indaiatuba, SP

Hybrid role – 3x a week at the office.
