title: Senior Sales Manager for Retail Media Brazil
description:
US Media is a Sales House specialized in Latin America, currently working with Tinder, vevo, WeTransfer, Sojern, Fandom and others.

We are a team that is making a massive impact and we are looking for a talented, ambitious and well-connected HUNGRY style digital ad sales professional to generate ad sales business.


Estamos buscando um Senior Sales Manager & Partner Management Retail Media para atuar na expansão de negócios no segmento de mídia, com foco em aquisição de novos clientes. Procuramos um profissional hunter, com forte capacidade de prospecção, negociação e fechamento de contratos. O candidato ideal deve ter experiência consolidada em vendas B2B, relacionamento com clientes de médio porte e profundo conhecimento do mercado de publicidade digital.  


Main Responsibilities:

✅ Prospectar e conquistar novos clientes no segmento retail media, focando em anunciantes diretos e agências.  

✅ Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas para impulsionar o crescimento da receita e expandir a carteira de clientes.  

✅ Construir e manter um pipeline sólido de oportunidades, gerenciando todo o ciclo de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos.  

✅ Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e propor soluções estratégicas em mídia digital, alinhadas às suas demandas e objetivos da área.

✅ Colaborar com times internos, como marketing, operações e customer success, para garantir entregas de alto impacto para os clientes.  

✅ Analisar tendências de mercado e concorrência, identificando novas oportunidades de crescimento.  

✅ Participar de eventos do setor, conferências e reuniões estratégicas para fortalecer o posicionamento da empresa no mercado.  


Experiência e Background

  • 3 a 6 anos de experiência comercial em mídia digital, e-commerce, adtech, ou plataformas de varejo.
  • Vivência em operações de Retail Media (ou em players correlatos: Criteo, CitrusAd, Amazon Ads, Mercado Ads, Walmart Connect, etc.).
  • Histórico comprovado em vendas consultivas B2B , preferencialmente com grandes anunciantes ou agências.
  • Experiência com performance media, trade marketing digital ou shopper marketing é um diferencial forte.


. Conhecimento Técnico

  • Entendimento sólido de estratégias de retail media on-site e off-site , DSPs e first-party data.
  • Noções de atribuição e mensuração de mídia (ROAS, incrementality, etc.).
  • Domínio das principais métricas de e-commerce (CTR, conversion rate, share of search, basket size, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Google Ads, DV360, Meta Ads Manager , e plataformas de retail media networks .


. Habilidades Comerciais e Comportamentais

  • Forte capacidade de storytelling e negociação com CMOs, heads de trade e agências .
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultado , com pensamento estratégico e postura consultiva.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com modelos híbridos de negócio (branding + performance).
  • Gestão de pipeline e forecasting , com disciplina comercial.
  • Comunicação clara, foco em relacionamento e alto grau de colaboração com times de operação e marketing .


 Idiomas

  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (muitas plataformas e dashboards são em inglês).
  • Espanhol avançado


O que oferecemos?

Remuneração atrativa, variável super competitiva baseado em performance 

Oportunidade de atuar em um mercado em crescimento, com grandes desafios e potencial de impacto  

Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, com alto nível de autonomia  

Benefícios e suporte ao desenvolvimento profissional

title: Field Support Specialist - Inglês Avançado (Conversação) - Presencial - Guarulhos/SP
description:
As an Field Support Specialist, you will be the focal point for ensuring the stability, security and efficiency of the company's all-areas. This role is critical to advanced technical support, administration and ongoing optimization of all infrastructure. We are looking for an experienced professional who can lead improvement initiatives and provide innovative solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Prepare projects and technical specifications, install, configure, provide support and manage various operating systems, access solutions, antivirus and specific applications.
  • Manage storage, backup and server virtualization solutions.
  • Work in administration and deployments of Microsoft, Linux, Vmware and Hyper-V Servers.
  • Monitor the implementation of new services in the environment, aiming to assimilate new technologies.
  • Maintain all environments managed, keeping them updated and configured in accordance with customer guidelines and best market practices.
  • Monitor and test environmental continuity procedures, recording them.
  • Develop and distribute software/configuration packages on a large scale.
  • Install and maintain server hardware.
  • Interact with manufacturers and service providers if necessary.
  • Provide support to the service desk in incidents and problems in order to resolve issues that exceed the solution conditions in that area.
  • Analyze the problems presented, opening problems in the company's support system, aiming for their resolution.
  • Analyze and research causes, solutions, technologies and costs involved in solving the problems encountered.
  • Recommend environmental improvement solutions.
  • Perform hands-on fixes, including installing and upgrading software, installing hardware,
  • Owns and drives issues to resolution including escalation to specialized resources within the broader IT organization. Remains engaged on issues until resolution.
  • Provide Tier 2 technical support for client facilities such as video conferencing and audio conferencing services.
  • Lead, coordinate and participate in improvements as they relate to the on-site IT environment.
  • Serves as an advocate for the organization’s information security management system. Assists customers to work efficiently within the ISMS framework.
  • Test fixes to ensure problems have been adequately resolved.
  • Perform post-resolution follow-ups to customer requests.
  • Evaluate documented resolutions and analyze trends for ways to prevent future problems.
  • Field incoming requests from customers via both telephone and e-mail in a courteous manner.
  • Build reports with customers.
  • Perform preventative maintenance, including checking and cleaning of workstations, printers, and peripherals.
  • Prioritize and escalate problems (when required).
  • Record, track, and document problem-solving processes, including all successful and unsuccessful decisions made, and actions taken, through to final resolution.
  • Apply diagnostic utilities to aid in troubleshooting.
  • Access software updates, drivers, knowledge bases, and frequently asked questions resources on the Internet to aid in problem resolution.
  • Understands the essential responsibilities of the position and works to continuously to build and improve the skills necessary to be proficient in the role.
  • Supports operates and maintains AV equipment for live meetings and events.
  • Provides support and demonstrates expert knowledge for online webinar tools and applications.


Job Holder Requirements

  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a focus on listening and asking probing questions as
  • appropriate.
  • Strong documentation skills.
  • Ability to conduct research into a wide range of computing issues as required.
  • Ability to absorb and retain information quickly.
  • Ability to present ideas in user-friendly language to non-technical staff and end users.
  • Keen attention to detail.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Exceptional customer service orientation.
  • Ability to represent and advocate for both the policies and procedures of the IT organization the end users’ perspective.
  • To resolve assigned tickets in adherence to agreed SLA and quality standards of the company
  • To maintain high login Efficiency (Availability) for customers
  • To resolve tickets within agreed SLA of ticket volume and time
  • To adhere to quality standards (voice and accent, Tech Monitoring), regulatory requirements and company policies
  • To ensure positive customer experience and CSAT through First Call Resolution and minimum average handling time (AHT), rejected resolutions / Reopen Cases
  • To update worklogs and follow shift/ escalation process and process compliance
  • Work on value adding activities such Knowledge base update & self-development.


Technical & Personal Skills:

  • Consistently demonstrates a positive attitude and approach.
  • Demonstrates enthusiasm and dedication.
  • Consistently displays initiative by proactively providing solutions and driving long term objectives toward completion.
  • Demonstrates empathy and focuses on the needs of internal and external clients/contacts where relevant.
  • Focuses on what can be done. When a problem exists, suggest a solution.
  • Builds relationships with stakeholders.
  • Maintains a courteous and professional manner in all dealings.
  • Complete higher education.
  • Postgraduate degree in IT is desirable.
  • Microsoft or Vmware certification preferred
  • Microsoft Windows server Support
  • MS Office Tools, O365, SharePoint, Teams
  • Hardware Support
  • Network Support and Troubleshooting
  • Videoconferencing Support
  • Peripheral Support
  • Monitoring Tools Knowledge
  • Tickets Tools Knowledge (Service Now)


Language Requirements :

  • English, Fluent (Required)


Por que nos escolher?


  • Somos uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia que mais crescem no mundo, com escritórios em mais de 54 países e 219.000 colaboradores
  • Nossa empresa é extremamente diversificada com 165 nacionalidades representadas
  • Oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar com colegas espalhados ao redor do mundo
  • Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho virtual em primeiro lugar, promovendo uma boa integração entre seu trabalho e vida pessoal, em uma flexibilidade real
  • Estamos comprometidos com seu crescimento, oferecendo oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento de carreira em todos os níveis para ajudá-lo a encontrar seu brilho único.
  • Oferecemos benefícios abrangentes para todos os funcionários
  • Somos certificados como "Great Place to Work" e "Top Employer" em 17 países, e reconhecidos como “Top Employer” no Brasil especificamente, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo que valoriza o reconhecimento e o respeito dos funcionários


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Sales Operations & Data Analyst
description:
Responsabilidades

▪️Apoiar o design, a automação e a escalabilidade de processos globais de Operações de Vendas por meio de ferramentas com tecnologia de IA (por exemplo, Microsoft Power Apps, Copilot, modelos de IA/ML) e soluções baseadas em dados.

▪️Criar, manter e otimizar painéis de relatórios no Power BI, Excel e SQL para gerar insights acionáveis e permitir a tomada de decisões com base em dados.

▪️Colaborar com stakeholders multifuncionais (Operações de Vendas, Operações Centrais, Produto, Engenharia) para identificar ineficiências, simplificar fluxos de trabalho e implementar soluções escaláveis.

▪️Desenvolver e documentar processos, fluxos de dados e fluxos de trabalho do estado atual vs. estado futuro para apoiar a transformação dos negócios.

▪️Identificar oportunidades para reduzir esforços manuais por meio de automações com Python, APIs ou soluções baseadas em IA.

▪️Atuar como defensor(a) do usuário para as equipes de Operações de Vendas e Vendas, garantindo que o design dos processos melhore a eficiência, a adoção e a usabilidade.

▪️Apoiar a governança de projetos mantendo acompanhamentos (trackers), canais de comunicação e registros de riscos/problemas para garantir responsabilidade e entregas.


Qualificações Básicas

▪️Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em Operações de Vendas, Operações de Negócios, Análise de Dados ou funções similares.

▪️Proficiência em SQL, Python, Power BI e Excel para analisar dados, criar relatórios e automatizar fluxos de trabalho.

▪️Experiência com a Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Query) ou ferramentas similares de automação low-code/no-code.

▪️Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas, com capacidade comprovada de simplificar processos complexos.

▪️Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em inglês e português.


☑️Qualificações Desejáveis

▪️Experiência na aplicação de ferramentas de IA/ML ou automação para otimizar operações, reduzir esforços manuais ou melhorar a tomada de decisão.

▪️Familiaridade com Salesforce (SFDC), Dynamics 365 (D365) ou outros sistemas CRM/ERP.

▪️Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em um ambiente global dinâmico.

▪️Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e capacidade de colaborar com equipes multiculturais e em diferentes fusos horários.

▪️Experiência com processos de vendas como planejamento de headcount, desenho de territórios, definição de metas ou previsão de vendas (forecasting).

▪️Demonstração de curiosidade e vontade de explorar novas fronteiras de excelência operacional por meio de tecnologia e inovação.

title: After-sales Service Manager
description:
About the Company



As the biggest engine manufacturer in China, Weichai Group is looking for a high-performance After-sales Service Manager for engine service and channel development. This position will be mainly responsible for the Brazil market, but also include the Guyana market, planning and implementing all directing activities of Weichai engines service activities.



About the Role



This role will focus on managing the operations of the service center and ensuring customer satisfaction through effective service management and continuous improvement activities.



Responsibilities



  • Manages all operations of service center including service staff and supervisors;
  • Resolves most complex business problems for those on the team;
  • Leads continuous improvement activities by reviewing, changing, and improving processes in line with changing customer expectations goals;
  • Responsible for the construction and optimization of local services and accessories network;
  • Responsible for maintaining relationship with main customer and improving customer satisfaction;
  • Responsible for researching competitive products in local market;
  • Responsible for the failure analysis and recommendations for product improvement;
  • Assists the company to complete the important projects in the local;
  • Assists with the transfer of knowledge; coaches and mentors less experienced technicians and engineers;
  • Investigate potential partners in the local market and select high quality service stations or accessory agents, and report to the branch office director;
  • Assess the operation status of existing local service stations and assist the director to promote the construction of boutique service stations;
  • Assist the director to make service management regulations for the main customer;
  • Assist the director gather valued market information (for example, the competitive products information, service policy, etc.) and assist the director make or update service policy according to the information;
  • Perform failure analysis on major or batch failures, propose improvement suggestion and report to the branch office director;
  • Provide necessary technical support for the local service station to solve knotty problems;
  • Report the accomplished and processed work every week;
  • Assist the company to complete the important Project;
  • Performs other related tasks as may be assigned.


Qualifications



  • Bachelor degree in Engineering or Mechanic;
  • At least 5 years in Diesel Engine Market;
  • Fluent level in English.


Required Skills



  • Relevant knowledge of Diesel Engines;
  • Proven tracking records in channel development;

SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.


Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.


In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.


Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms


Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Telecommunications Project Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Project Manager in the Telecommunications sector to lead complex initiatives involving network deployment, modernization, and expansion. This professional will be responsible for delivering projects on time, within scope, budget, and quality standards, while ensuring strong alignment between clients, technical teams, vendors, and senior management.


This is a full on-site position at our São Paulo – Berrini office.



Key Responsibilities


  • Plan, execute, monitor, and close telecom projects (RAN, Core, IP, FTTH, DWDM, power and site infrastructure).
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and quality indicators (SLAs, KPIs), ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams (engineering, deployment, logistics, suppliers, and subcontractors).
  • Lead regular meetings with telecom operators and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency, governance, and alignment.
  • Identify, analyze, and mitigate technical, operational, and commercial risks.
  • Prepare and present executive reports to clients and senior management, highlighting progress, risks, and key decisions.
  • Ensure compliance with telecom regulations (e.g., ANATEL) and international quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management processes, aiming at efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management, Telecommunications, or related areas is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in project management, with a strong background in the telecommunications sector.
  • Solid experience in project management within the telecommunications sector (mobile networks, fixed networks, or backbone).
  • Strong technical knowledge of telecom technologies (4G/5G RAN, IP/MPLS, DWDM, FTTH, power and infrastructure for telecom sites).
  • Proven experience managing projects of high complexity, involving multiple vendors and Tier-1 telecom operators.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies (PMBOK, Agile, hybrid).
  • Certifications are a plus: PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, ITIL.
  • English is the primary working language; fluency is required. Portuguese fluency both written and spoken is a must.
  • Availability to work full on-site at the São Paulo – Berrini office.



Preferred Competencies


  • Strong leadership skills and ability to engage technical and field teams.
  • Excellent negotiation skills with clients, partners, and vendors.
  • Established professional relationship with major Brazilian telecom operators (TIM, Claro, Vivo, Oi/Algar) is highly desirable.
  • Analytical thinking and result-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work under pressure in demanding and dynamic environments.
  • Clear and structured communication for both technical and executive audiences.



What We Offer


  • Opportunity to lead high-impact projects for major telecom operators.
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with direct interface with international stakeholders.
  • Competitive compensation package and continuous training programs.

description:

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;

A pessoa que ocupar esta função será responsável por oferecer suporte administrativo e operacional a diferentes áreas da organização, garantindo que as atividades do dia a dia fluam de forma eficiente e organizada. A função de Secretária Administrativa é fundamental para a integração dos processos internos, servindo como elo entre diferentes setores. Essa posição garante a eficiência das operações diárias e contribui diretamente para que a gestão mantenha foco nas decisões estratégicas, sabendo que as rotinas administrativas estão sob controle.

title: Leader-Merchant Informatization
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  4. Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.


Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

  • Maintain chosen ADP data base management tool and adhere to the current defined sales processes


Education and Experience:

  • 3-5 years of new business sales experience in IT Solutions / Services / HR in Brazil
  • Full Right to Work and a full driving licence in Brasil
  • Commutable to São Paolo 3 days per week
  • Experience in outbound lead generation and proactively growing a new business territory
  • A background of carrying and achieving / exceeding annual net new business annual quotas excess of $300k (USD)
  • Track record of managing complex sales cycles and closing deals in the $50-100k (USD) annual revenue range
  • Ideally you will have experience selling multi country products, but this is not essential
  • Must be fluent in Portuguese and English


What We Offer. This role offers the perfect platform for sales professionals to be fully supported to win global, complex deals, develop their career, and earn:


  • World class, structured induction programme
  • Highly competitive salary and compensation plan
  • A world class induction programme and individual on-going training – both locally and internationally
  • Realistic targets and earnings - we support our associates to overachieve.
  • We also celebrate success regularly with early starts, quarterly and annual awards, clubs and trips. Recent examples include everything from all-inclusive cruises, to local sports events and luxury 5 start resort vacations.
  • Excellent sales support and enablement teams to help you get there! We offer Sales Development Representatives and Marketing support to help generate leads. Then there's a full pre-sales team who are there to support you with everything from client assessments, recommendation documentation and software demonstrations
  • Global brand, 75+ years of heritage, and a strong presence in Brasil and LATAM
  • Flexible benefits program


If this sounds like you and what you're looking for, or if you'd like to learn more, then please do get in touch!

title: Analista de Controladoria de Fundos
description:
Sobre a Prisma:

A Prisma Capital é uma empresa de investimentos alternativos fundada em 2017 que oferece soluções criativas para problemas complexos que exigem capital de longo prazo. A equipe da Prisma Capital é experiente, multidisciplinar e com um histórico de mais de R$ 12bi implantados com retornos atrativos. A Prisma tem sede em São Paulo, 66 funcionários e possui em torno de R$ 22bi sob gestão.


A Prisma tem um mandato de investimento altamente flexível que inclui um espectro completo de transações estruturadas, independentemente do tamanho, classe de ativo ou setor. A Prisma acredita que essa abordagem multiestratégia é fundamental para a geração de retornos não correlacionados com os ciclos macroeconômicos brasileiros.


Overview da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Controladoria com boa comunicação, senso crítico, com forte atenção aos detalhes e comprometido com a alta qualidade das entregas. O profissional será responsável por criar, implementar e acompanhar controles rigorosos para os ativos e passivos de toda a estrutura de fundos onshore e offshore da nossa gestora, além de coordenar o processo de auditoria e revisar as demonstrações financeiras e contábeis dos fundos.


Responsabilidade:

  • Controle das carteiras (Divulgação de cotas, reconciliação de informações divulgadas pelo administrador, validação de cálculos);
  • Suporte a áreas internas (Relatórios para investidores, fornecimento de informações regulatórias);
  • Suporte ao processo de auditoria dos fundos e revisão de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Controle de cotistas (Reconciliação das posições, análise de distribuições, chamadas de capital etc.);
  • Análise da rentabilidade dos fundos (Variações nos valores dos ativos e passivos, análise dos impactos mais relevantes);
  • Marcação a mercado de diversos tipos de ativos, líquidos e ilíquidos (Revisão e validação da precificação dos ativos em carteira, comparações com modelagens gerenciais);
  • Coordenação do processo de avaliação de ativos de Private Equity;


Desejável:

  • Coordenação das atividades de US tax compliance e reports de FATCA/CRS com prestadores;
  • Interface com administrador de fundos offshore sediados em Cayman, Canadá e USA, instruindo e revisando a contabilidade, demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, Econômicas, Contábeis, Administração e Engenharias;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência anterior em asset management ou similar;
  • Diferencial: experiência em fundos offshore com investidores estrangeiros.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse Architect About the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer / Team Lead focused in Azure to design, build, and scale core platform features across our admin portal, automation services, and cloud functions. This role covers both back-end and front-end development, with a focus on secure, scalable, enterprise-ready systems.


Required Skills & Experience

  • English (B2+)
  • 8+ years of professional in Azure environnt
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and React.
  • Proven experience with GraphQL APIs, Azure Functions, and microservices.
  • Proficiency in Azure SaaS platforms and cloud components (CosmosDB, Front Door, Key Vault, Redis).
  • Deep knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep/Terraform), GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codacy, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
  • Solid understanding of security and compliance frameworks (JWT, RBAC, encryption, managed identities).
  • Ability to manage multi-repo environments with interdependent services.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing admin portals with role-based access control.
  • Familiarity with data visualization frameworks (Recharts, D3, Grafana-style dashboards).
  • Understanding of AI/automation frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar).
  • Background in enterprise SaaS or observability platforms.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor engineering teams, setting standards for code quality and delivery.
  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across core repos (Admin Portal, IAC, AZFUNC, Platform).
  • Develop and optimize APIs and microservices (Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, Azure Functions).
  • Architect and manage Infrastructure-as-Code deployments (Bicep, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Build secure and performant admin and customer-facing portals (React, Tailwind, shadcn, Recharts).
  • Enhance observability, routing, and automation modules per evolving architecture needs.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and multi-repo workflows.
  • Optimize data flows and caching (CosmosDB, Redis, DataLoader).
  • Ensure compliance and security standards (RBAC, managed identities, Defender, SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR).
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, and AI/automation teams to deliver enterprise-grade solutions.

title: Founding Full-Stack Product Engineer (Senior)
description:
AutoReel is the #1 AI Real Estate Video Platform helping thousands of real estate agents and photographers generate stunning property videos from photos in minutes. We're growing fast and are looking for an exceptional Fullstack Product Engineer to own major features end-to-end. You are scrappy, hungry, driven, and willing to ship very fast with us as we reimagine real estate video marketing with AI.


What You'll Do:

  • Own significant features from ideation, design, implementation, deployment, and optimization
  • Build both frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Python/Django) components

Who You Are:

  • 4-8 years of full-stack development experience, building and shipping real products used by users
  • Expert React (TypeScript) and Python (Django) skills

Why AutoReel?

  • AI-first company: work with cutting-edge technology that's changing how businesses operate. Use AI through every aspect of your workflow to accelerate work and deliver a higher quality product.

  • Proven traction: thousands of users, growing revenue, strong customer testimonials
  • High impact role: your code directly affects customer success and company growth
  • Competitive compensation with strong performance based bonuses


Our Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Python, Django, PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Docker
  • AI/ML: Computer Vision, Video Processing, Distributed systems

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job 

In SME credit, advantage compounds through disciplined underwriting, fast learning cycles, and early detection of risks. As our Credit Analyst, you will strengthen our underwriting edge by translating financial data, behavioural signals, and real-world borrower performance into precise credit decisions- while continuously feeding insights back into our core decision models.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct holistic credit analysis for SMEs: financials, cash-flows, tax compliance, bank data, concentration risks, behavioural signals.
  • Produce concise, decision-ready credit memos with recommendations (approve / adjust / decline).
  • Lead periodic reviews of high-exposure borrowers - liquidity evolution, leverage shifts, payment patterns, and macro impacts.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit-limit increases based on performance, updated financials, and risk appetite.
  • Maintain a closed-loop feedback mechanism between underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data to translate recurring insights into better thresholds, features, and model logic.
  • Support portfolio monitoring with early-warning detection and risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure underwriting discipline and audit-ready documentation.


Qualifications

  • 2–3 years in IB, credit, structured credit, asset management, DCM or fintech underwriting.
  • Strong financial analysis: liquidity, leverage, coverage, working-capital dynamics, seasonality.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian tax reporting, accounting regimes, and corporate structures.
  • Experience writing clear, investor-grade credit memos.
  • Understanding of credit models (inputs, outputs, sensitivity) and ability to evaluate their strengths/weaknesses.
  • Bonus: exposure to securitisation, structured credit, data-driven underwriting.
  • High analytical rigor and precision in judgment.
  • “Manager of one”- delivers independently with consistency.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, both in English and Portuguese.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and model improvement opportunities.
  • Thrives in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment.
  • Passion for modernising Brazil’s B2B credit market through technology and transparency.
  • Integrity, long-term thinking, and intellectual honesty.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Itaim Bibi, Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

title: Data Scientist

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of hands-on experience as a data scientist in a business environment, supporting multiple departments and functions with predictive analytics and rapid development of minimal viable products (MVPs). A strong emphasis is placed on experience with pricing engines and sales forecasting solutions. You will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.

  • Support various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations) with tailored predictive models and insights.
  • Visualize data insights using dashboards and reports, primarily with Power BI.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through presentations and documentation.
  • Continuously improve data quality, analytical processes, and model performance.
  • Stay current with the latest trends and technologies in data science, machine learning, and AI.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of proven experience as a data scientist in a business setting, supporting multiple departments/functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing predictive models for pricing engines and sales forecasting.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Industry experience in Construction is preferred; experience in Manufacturing or Engineering-related Big Data is also relevant.

title: Gerente SHE
description:
O Gerente de SHE é responsável pela implementação, otimização e gestão de processos da área de Segurança do Trabalho dentro de uma organização. Ele garante que a operação dos serviços seja eficientes, alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da área.

  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Promover a comunicação entre a Segurança e a gerência/diretoria dos sites.
  • Oferecer suporte ao negócio ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto desde o planejamento, supervisão, monitoramento e documentação para assegurar a conformidade com os aspectos internos, externos e legais relacionados.

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Testing and commissioning Engineer to join our dynamic team for Data Center projects in Brazil. This position demands a solid foundation in electrical engineering, particularly in testing and Commissioning power generation equipment. The ideal candidate will ensure that all equipment and systems adhere to Industry standards and regulatory requirements through thorough and safe testing processes. Responsibilities will encompass managing all aspects of testing, including Factory acceptance Tests (FAT), Site acceptance Tests (Sat), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). The engineer should be proficient in developing and executing test plans That align with customer needs while maintaining clear communication with the factory.


Key responsibilities:

  • Actual participation in testing and commissioning activities including FAT, SAT, and IST;
  • Ensure adherence to industry regulations and safety standards during testing and commissioning processes;
  • Develop and implement testing protocols to validate system functionality and performance according to customer specificity;
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to testing and commissioning;
  • Collaborate with project teams to incorporate testing and commissioning activities into overall project plans;
  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred;
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning power generator preferred;
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical testing and commissioning (E.g., IEEE, IEC, NEC);
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and capacity to analyze complex electrical systems;
  • Experience in project management or coordination is a plus;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team;
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality;
  • This position may require travel to project sites or customer locations, both locally and internationally as needed.

*Please note that this is a 1 year renewable contract position*

title: Risk Management Manager
description:
As the Safety Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of safety risk

management at Keeta.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Lead data analysis and modeling for platform risk scenarios
  • Conduct risk identification, classification, and early-warning analysis across rider/driver/courier, merchant, and customer segments.
  • Perform bottom-up data discovery and metric construction
  • Conduct in-depth EDA using raw mobility/delivery platform data (orders, location traces, incentives, behavioral logs).
  • Build standardized risk metrics, operational metrics, behavior features, and monitoring indicators from the ground up.
  • Apply top-down business perspective to drive strategy and execution
  • Work closely with product, operations, policy, and risk teams to translate high-level business goals into measurable and actionable metrics.
  • Drive 0→1 metric system design for new markets or new products, and evolve metrics for rapid growth and later-stage refinement.
  • Develop dashboards and risk monitoring systems
  • Build and maintain BI dashboards to monitor key risk, quality, safety, and operational metrics.
  • Detect anomalies, conduct root-cause analysis, and support incident response and post-mortem reviews.
  • Support cross-functional decision making and risk strategy design
  • Provide data-driven insights to support risk mitigation strategies, counter-measure design, operational policy updates, and business optimization.
  • Evaluate the impact of policy or product changes, and create closed-loop measurement frameworks.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Data Science, or related fields.


Technical Skills


  • Proficient in SQL and Python/R for data processing, modeling, and analysis.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning methods (logistic regression, decision trees, anomaly detection, clustering) is preferred.
  • Strong ability to understand raw data structures and build robust metric definitions.
  • Risk Experience (Core Requirement)
  • Experience in risk analytics, trust & safety, fraud detection, operational risk, or platform governance—preferably in mobility, delivery, or other two-sided marketplace industries.
  • Familiar with risk assessment lifecycle: identification → quantification → monitoring → mitigation.
  • Bottom-Up Analytical Capability
  • Ability to investigate raw data (orders, trajectory data, incentives, cancellations, GPS signals, courier/driver behavior) and derive structured metrics and actionable insights.
  • Top-Down Business and Strategy Thinking
  • Ability to understand business models such as supply-demand balancing, delivery SLA, driver/courier incentives, merchant performance, and safety/quality frameworks.
  • Proven experience in designing and scaling 0→1→N metric systems supporting business objectives.
  • Project Experience (strong preferred but not necessary)
  • Experience supporting new market entry, new product launches, or rapid-scale operations is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical reasoning, structured communication, and data storytelling abilities.
  • Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with high attention to detail.

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company



Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.



Our Valued Behaviors


  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.



About Actabl's Product Design Team


We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.


Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out Actabl Design here .



Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.



You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile


You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.


  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.



Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

A falta de tempo sempre foi considerada inimiga da alimentação saudável. Quem nunca precisou recorrer a fast-food por dispor de apenas alguns minutos para almoçar?


Para nós da Piadina Romagnola, toda refeição deve ser gostosa e saudável. Uma refeição rápida pode ter um atendimento com atenção e empatia. Uma refeição rápida não precisa ser cheia de gorduras, frituras e alimentos processados. E por fim, comida saudável não precisa ser sem graça.

Com 14 unidades estabelecidas nos melhores bairros de São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro e mais de 100 mil piadinas vendidas a cada mês, estamos crescendo e sonhando grande para os próximos anos.


Venha construir e sonhar junto com a gente!

Proatividade, organização, atenção aos detalhes, boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;


Capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico;


Conhecimento do pacote Office, especialmente Excel.
